objective: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.

description: To think all this time that the reason Linken came here was to rid us of Blazerunner... He seems like such an ordinary guy, but I did notice that he's not at all interested in any of my experiments or gadgets like most gnomes would be. He must be a true warrior at heart.
Bring the totem to him. See if that helps him remember why he came here.
completion: Did J.D. help you at all?
